Migration.Name: Fix_QtyToDeliver_OutboundOrderToShip_SB
Migration.Comments: OutboundOrderToShipSB Qty to deliver column computed the order line's overall open balance instead of this outbound line's own committed quantity minus what has actually shipped for it, so a partial Outbound Order showed the full order balance instead of its own committed amount

PO.Data: iobl.MovementQty - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(iol.MovementQty) FROM M_InOutLine iol INNER JOIN M_InOut io ON (io.M_InOut_ID = iol.M_InOut_ID) WHERE iol.WM_InOutBoundLine_ID = iobl.WM_InOutBoundLine_ID AND io.DocStatus IN ('CO','CL')), 0)
